body.en:
Start with a situation

A hot moving part,a fluid and a shiny metal surface do not all suit the same thermometer.

Definition

Temperature measurement estimates the thermal state of a defined object/location through a calibrated temperature-dependent property.

Understand the reason

Contact sensors need adequate heat transfer and time;non-contact sensors infer surface temperature from radiation with optical/material assumptions.

Example / application

Specify surface vs bulk,range,response time,access,safety and uncertainty before choosing a method.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A digital number can represent the sensor temperature rather than the intended object temperature if installation is poor.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

ગરમ moving part,fluid અને ચમકતી metal surface માટે એક જ thermometer યોગ્ય નથી.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Temperature measurementમાં defined object/locationની thermal stateનો calibrated temperature-dependent propertyથી અંદાજ કરીએ.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Contact sensorમાં પૂરતું heat transfer અને time જોઈએ;non-contactમાં optical/material assumptions સાથે radiationથી surface temperature કાઢીએ.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Method પહેલાં surface કે bulk,range,response time,access,safety,uncertainty નક્કી કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Installation ખરાબ હોય તો digital number intended object નહિ,sensorનું temperature બતાવી શકે.

body.en:
Definition

A thermocouple uses the Seebeck effect:two dissimilar conductors generate a thermoelectric emf related to their temperature distribution and junction/reference temperatures.

Construction:parts and purpose

Two specified dissimilar conductors form the thermocouple pair.

The measuring junction contacts or approaches the target location.

Reference terminals and a temperature sensor support cold-junction compensation(CJC).

Correct extension/compensating cable,polarity and connectors preserve the circuit.

A high-input-impedance instrument uses the type-specific emf relation.

Working:sequence and reason

Choose the type,range,protection and response appropriate to the environment.

Install for adequate thermal contact/immersion while controlling conduction error.

Measure the thermoelectric emf and reference-terminal temperature.

Apply CJC in equivalent-emf form and invert the calibrated table/polynomial.

Allow stabilisation and report uncertainty,location and conditions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Thermocouples do not directly measure absolute temperature from emf alone;CJC does not physically cool the terminals to0°C.The emf relation is generally nonlinear.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Thermocouple Seebeck effect વાપરે:બે dissimilar conductors temperature distribution અને junction/reference temperatures સંબંધિત thermoelectric emf આપે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

બે specified dissimilar conductors thermocouple pair બનાવે.

Measuring junction target locationને contact/approach કરે.

Reference terminals અને temperature sensor cold-junction compensation(CJC) આપે.

યોગ્ય extension/compensating cable,polarity,connectors circuit જાળવે.

High-input-impedance instrument type-specific emf relation વાપરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Environment પ્રમાણે type,range,protection,response લો.

Conduction error નિયંત્રિત કરી thermal contact/immersion સાથે install કરો.

Thermoelectric emf અને reference-terminal temperature માપો.

Equivalent-emf formમાં CJC આપી calibrated table/polynomialથી temperature કાઢો.

Stabilisation આપીને uncertainty,location,conditions જણાવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Thermocouple ફક્ત emfથી સીધું absolute temperature નથી માપતું;CJC terminalsને ખરેખર0°C ઠંડા નથી કરતું.Emf relation સામાન્ય રીતે nonlinear છે.

body.en:
Given

Assume a constant sensitivityS40microV/°C only over a declared narrow range.Reference25°C,measured emf3.000mV.

Stepwise solution

  1. Delta T=3000microV/(40microV/°C)=75°C
  2. Tmeasuring≈25+75=100°C

Remember / avoid this mistake

This is a linear teaching model,not a substitute for a real thermocouple type table/CJC calculation across a broad range.

Quick check: Does0mV prove0°C at the measuring junction?

No.It can mean equal measuring/reference temperatures within the model and valid circuit conditions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

જાહેર કરેલી સાંકડી rangeમાં sensitivity S40microV/°C constant માનો.Reference25°C,measured emf3.000mV.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Delta T=3000microV/(40microV/°C)=75°C
  2. Tmeasuring≈25+75=100°C

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ linear teaching model છે;મોટી rangeમાં real thermocouple type table/CJC calculationનો વિકલ્પ નહિ.

જાતે વિચારો: 0mV એટલે Measuring Junction0°C?

ના.Valid circuit/modelમાં measuring/reference temperatures સરખાં પણ હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition

A pyrometer infers temperature from thermal radiation,allowing measurement without physical contact when conditions permit.

Construction:parts and purpose

An optical system defines the viewed target and spectral band.

A radiation detector or optical brightness-comparison system senses intensity.

An emissivity/calibration model relates radiation to temperature.

A display/readout presents the inferred surface temperature.

Working:sequence and reason

Select a suitable spectral/range system for the target material and temperature.

Ensure the target fills the effective field of view and the optical path is suitable.

Use the specified emissivity/reflection corrections or qualified comparison method.

In a classical disappearing-filament instrument,match filament brightness to the target image under the defined method.

Read the calibrated temperature and assess atmosphere/window/reflection errors.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Brightness temperature is not automatically true thermodynamic surface temperature;emissivity and spectral conditions matter.Never view intense sources except through approved protected instrumentation.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Pyrometer thermal radiationથી temperature કાઢે;conditions યોગ્ય હોય તો physical contact વગર માપી શકાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Optical system viewed target અને spectral band નક્કી કરે.

Radiation detector કે optical brightness-comparison intensity લે.

Emissivity/calibration model radiationને temperature સાથે જોડે.

Display inferred surface temperature આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Material,temperature માટે યોગ્ય spectral/range system લો.

Target effective field of view ભરે અને optical path યોગ્ય હોય તે જુઓ.

Specified emissivity/reflection corrections કે qualified comparison method લો.

Classical disappearing-filamentમાં defined methodથી filament brightnessને target image સાથે match કરો.

Calibrated temperature વાંચી atmosphere/window/reflection errors જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Brightness temperature આપમેળે true surface temperature નથી;emissivity,spectral conditions મહત્વનાં છે.Intense source માત્ર approved protected instrumentationથી જ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition

An IR sensor detects radiation in a defined infrared band and applies a calibrated model to estimate surface temperature.

Construction:parts and purpose

Lens/aperture define field of view and spot size.

An IR detector senses the incoming band radiation.

Internal temperature compensation and processing support interpretation.

Emissivity settings and output/display complete the instrument.

Working:sequence and reason

Confirm the material,emissivity,range and optical path.

Aim so the required target fills the specified measurement spot.

Account for reflected surroundings and any window transmission.

Allow instrument stabilisation and read with validated settings.

Compare with a suitable reference method where needed and record conditions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A laser dot is normally an aiming aid,not the whole sensing area.Shiny low-emissivity metal can reflect a hot source and give a misleading reading.Do not assume ordinary glass transmits the sensor IR band.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

IR sensor defined infrared bandનું radiation શોધી calibrated modelથી surface temperatureનો અંદાજ કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Lens/aperture field of view,spot size આપે.

IR detector incoming band radiation લે.

Internal temperature compensation,processing interpretation આપે.

Emissivity settings,output/display instrument પૂરું કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Material,emissivity,range,optical path તપાસો.

Target specified measurement spot ભરે તેમ aim કરો.

Reflected surroundings અને window transmissionની અસર જુઓ.

Instrument stable થવા દઈ validated settingsથી વાંચો.

જરૂર પડે યોગ્ય reference methodથી સરખાવી conditions નોંધો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Laser dot સામાન્ય રીતે aiming aid છે,આખો sensing area નહિ.Shiny low-emissivity metal hot source reflect કરી ખોટું reading આપે.સામાન્ય glass sensor IR band પસાર કરે એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Given

For a stated approximate distance-to-spot ratio12:1 at the working distance600mm,neglect the specified lens-offset correction only for this exercise.

Stepwise solution

  1. Approximate spot diameter=600/12=50mm
  2. A20mm target cannot be assumed to fill that50mm spot;the reading may include its surroundings.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use the actual manufacturer field-of-view diagram,minimum focus and required target margin for real measurements.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Working distance600mm પર stated approximate distance-to-spot ratio12:1 છે;આ exerciseમાં જ specified lens-offset correction અવગણો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Approximate spot diameter=600/12=50mm
  2. 20mm target આ50mm spot ભરે એમ ન માની શકાય;readingમાં surroundings આવી શકે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Real measurementમાં manufacturer field-of-view diagram,minimum focus,target margin લો.

h.gu: 8.1.7 Digital Temperature Sensorમાં અંદર શું હોય?

body.en:
Definition

A digital temperature sensor combines a temperature-sensitive element with conversion/interface electronics;the sensing principle may be semiconductor,resistive or another calibrated property.

Understand the reason

A semiconductor IC sensor uses temperature-dependent junction behaviour with on-chip processing.An RTD uses resistance variation;over a limited range R≈R0[1+alpha(T−T0)].

A thermistor has a strong usually nonlinear resistance-temperature response;NTC resistance decreases with increasing temperature over its intended range.

Construction chain:element→excitation/conditioning as needed→ADC/processing→digital interface.Working:establish thermal contact,wait for response,read validated data and convert with the device calibration.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Digital output is not a promise of high accuracy;self-heating,stem/board conduction,lead effects,conversion error and installation still matter.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Digital temperature sensor temperature-sensitive element સાથે conversion/interface electronics જોડે;sensing principle semiconductor,resistive કે બીજું calibrated property હોઈ શકે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Semiconductor IC junctionના temperature-dependent behaviour સાથે on-chip processing વાપરે.RTD resistance variation વાપરે;limited rangeમાં R≈R0[1+alpha(T−T0)].

Thermistorનું resistance-temperature response મજબૂત અને સામાન્ય રીતે nonlinear છે;NTCમાં intended rangeમાં temperature વધે ત્યારે resistance ઘટે.

Construction chain:element→જરૂરી excitation/conditioning→ADC/processing→digital interface.Working:thermal contact લો,response માટે રાહ જુઓ,validated data વાંચી device calibrationથી ફેરવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Digital output high accuracyનું વચન નથી;self-heating,stem/board conduction,lead effects,conversion error,installation મહત્વનાં રહે.

body.en:
Understand the reason

Thermocouple:wide type-dependent range and rugged options,small nonlinear emf and reference compensation.IR/pyrometer:moving or inaccessible surfaces,with emissivity/optical constraints.

RTD/digital contact sensor:often useful for controlled moderate-temperature measurements within its rating,with response/contact/self-heating limitations.

Build an exam answer

  1. Define the principle→label the sensing/reference/conditioning parts→explain working and compensation→state applications→list installation/error limits.
Quick check: Will an IR sensor normally measure core temperature?

No.It estimates the viewed surface temperature;bulk/core needs an appropriate method.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Thermocouple:type પ્રમાણે wide range,rugged options,નાનું nonlinear emf,reference compensation.IR/pyrometer:moving/inaccessible surfaces,પણ emissivity/optical constraints.

RTD/digital contact sensor પોતાની ratingમાં controlled moderate-temperature measurements માટે ઘણી વાર ઉપયોગી,response/contact/self-heating limitations સાથે.

પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Principle define→sensing/reference/conditioning parts label→Working,compensation→Applications→installation/error limits.
જાતે વિચારો: IR Sensor સામાન્ય રીતે Core Temperature માપે?

ના.Viewed surfaceનો અંદાજ આપે;bulk/core માટે યોગ્ય method જોઈએ.

T(K)=t(°C)+273.15
Linear teaching model:E≈S(Th−Tref)
Approximate spot=D/(D:S)
RTD limited-range model:R≈R0[1+alpha(T−T0)]

a.gu: Equivalent-emf compensationથી reference-terminal temperatureની અસર ગણવી.

a.gu: Rangeમાં temperature વધે તો resistance ઘટે.
